Having overcome the accidents, the URA 
Finals were now set to be held safely.

Having successfully gained enough fans to 
truly deserve the title of "Star 
Umamusume," <chrname>'s entry into the race was 
officially set!

Having gained overwhelming support as a 
"Star Umamusume," <chrname> is naturally going to 
run as well!

With the news that Trainer Kiryuin and 
Happy Meek were officially cleared to run, 
everyone was more fired up than ever for 
the big event!
